title: 11.39% gains in one week.
author: Zephyr_Labs
selftext:
After rigorous months of handling one fucking problem after another, I finally had a solid week of not touching the damn system and watching it run from market open to market close.

After 20 ish trades it won 86% of the time and netted over 10% after trading costs. 

We will see if it can do it again next week.

comments.author: crakkerzz
